where: Maitland, Woltemade Cemetery, Cape Town - album "Le", image 85 of 127 in the eGGSA collection, photographed 2021 by Heather MacAlister
why_it_matters: The only physical trace of this family found anywhere. The kerb carries the surname and NOTHING else - no forename, no dates. Both Mary Septima (grave 7719A, Nov 1935) and Pablo Armando (Maitland Cemetery no 1, Mar 1950) are buried in this cemetery.
what_to_capture: The WHOLE plot, not just the kerb: any plate or slab, the section and row markers, the neighbouring graves, and a wide shot showing where it sits. Then ask the municipal cemetery office for the Woltemade register entry - a grave number would tie the kerb to a person.

why_it_matters: Where he died on 19 March 1950, and where his executrix Rose Lilian Theys - "no relation" - also lived. The house is very likely still standing.
what_to_capture: The street frontage, the number, and enough of the street to place it.

what: The stables site, Koeberg Road, Rugby
why_it_matters: Plans were lodged in 1931 for stables here - KAB 3/CT 4/2/1/3/474 B796. The direct documentary corroboration of the horse tradition, and the yard where Alan Higgins and Peter Kannemeyer were apprenticed to "Bob Lerena".
what_to_capture: Whatever is on the site now, and the road. Even a negative - a warehouse, a car park - is worth recording.

why_it_matters: Where Mary Septima died in November 1935.
Where they married on 3 September 1911, after banns.
what_to_capture: The exterior, and the interior if it is open.

why_it_matters: Where Roque was baptised on 12 June 1911, three months before his parents' wedding.
